texts.preamble: Suo Moto In Re- Public Health - Protect ... vs Union Of India on 1 July, 2024 Author: Anoop Kumar Dhand Bench: Anoop Kumar Dhand 1 High Court Of Judicature For Rajasthan Bench At Jaipur In Re: Public Health - Protect The Present And Safeguard The Future From Food Adulteration Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anoop Kumar Dhand Order 01/07/2024 Reportable By the Court: 1.
texts.facts: (f) State Level Committee, headed by the Chief Secretary and the Additional & Principal Secretary of Health Welfare and Food Department along with District Level Committee, headed by the concerned District Collector shall be constituted to take a review of the work done in curbing the adulteration by the authorities. (g) The Central Government as well as the State Government and the concerned Departments are directed to set-up a website that will be responsible for creating awareness about complaint mechanism functioning and the responsibilities of the food safety authorities. The website will have the contact details of Food Safety Officers and a toll-free number as well.
texts.arguments: The important issue involved in this Petition is adulteration in food affecting the health of public at large.
